name: TwIL-LM3
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 65536). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B: 36 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-23. A finetune of HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.075 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-08-03.

benchmarks.name: Rule induction (derivation score)
benchmarks.config: Card figure ('Outreasoning the Data Center', sub-chart 'Rules from data / kgw addition / execution score'), leftmost TwIL-LM3 bar.
